title: Taqibaat e Namaz e Fajr (1)
introduction:
TAQIBAAT E NAMAZ E FAJR

As quoted from Misbah al-Mutahajjid

Subsequent to the dawn (fajr) (fajr) Prayer, say the following supplicatory prayer, as quoted from Misbah al-Mutahajjid:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

verses.arabic: وَ اهْدِنِيْ لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِاِذْنِكَ
verses.translation: and guide me, by Your permission, to the right about which discrepancies have taken place.

verses.arabic: اِنَّكَ تَهْدِيْ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ۔
verses.translation: Verily, You guide him whom You wish to a straight path.
Again, repeat the following invocation ten times:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
the consenting and pleased Successors,
with the best of Your blessings,
and confer upon them the best of your favors.
Peace be upon them
and their souls and bodies.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon them.

This invocation of God’s blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household has been also reported to be said on Fridays with a great reward.

Also, say the following:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَحْيِنِيْ عَلٰى مَاۤ اَحْيَيْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَلِيَّ بْنَ اَبِي طَالِبٍ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) make me live carrying the conducts on which You made 'Ali the son of Abu-Talib live

verses.arabic: وَ اَمِتْنِيْ عَلٰى مَا مَاتَ عَلَيْهِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ۔
verses.translation: and make me die on the principles for which 'Ali the son of Abu-Talib—peace be upon him—died.
Also, repeat each of the following statements one hundred times:
(1) I pray the forgiveness of Allah and I repent before Him.
(2) I beseech Allah for good health.
(3) I seek Allah’s protection against Hellfire.
(4) I ask Him for Paradise.
(5) I ask Allah for the Paradisiacal Women.

verses.arabic: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِيْنُ
verses.translation: (6) There is no god save Allah the King and evident Truth.
(7) Surah al-Tawhid

verses.arabic: صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: (8) May Allah send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
(9) All glory be to Allah,
all praise be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,
Allah is the Greatest,

verses.arabic: وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ۔
verses.translation: and there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All- high and All-great.

verses.arabic: مَا شَاۤءَ اللهُ كَانَ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ۔
verses.translation: (10) Only that which Allah wills shall come to pass and there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high and All¬great.
You may then say the following:
O Allah, I have begun this morning seeking refuge with Your invulnerable security

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْ لَا يُطَاوَلُ وَ لَا يُحَاوَلُ
verses.translation: that is neither touched nor caught

verses.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ غَاشِمٍ وَ طَارِقٍ
verses.translation: against the evil of all oppressive and domineering ones

verses.arabic: مِنْ سَاۤئِرِ مَنْ خَلَقْتَ وَ مَا خَلَقْتَ
verses.translation: from among all Your animate and inanimate creatures
both the silent and the speaking;
and being in protection against all terrifying things;
and being in the complete garb
of my loyalty to the Household of Your Prophet;

verses.arabic: مُحْتَجِبًا مِنْ كُلِّ قَاصِدٍ لِيْ اِلٰى اَذِيَّةٍ
verses.translation: and veiling myself against all those who intend harm to me,
behind an impervious wall,
which is my sincerity in the profession of their (Divinely commissioned) right (of leadership)
and my adherence to their Rope,

verses.arabic: مُوْقِنًا اَنَّ الْحَقَّ لَهُمْ وَ مَعَهُمْ
verses.translation: and bearing with certainty that the Right is theirs, with them,
in them, and amid them.
I thus accede to those whom they accept
and depart those whom they depart.
O Allah, protect me, in the names of them,

verses.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَا اَتَّقِيْهِ يَا عَظِيْمُ
verses.translation: against the evil of all that which I fear, O All-great.

verses.arabic: حَجَزْتُ الْاَعَادِيَ عَنِّي بِبَدِيْعِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ
verses.translation: I am restraining the enemies against me through the Originator of the heavens and the earth;

verses.arabic: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ اَيْدِيْهِمْ سَدًّا
verses.translation: “And We have set a bar before them
and a bar behind them,
and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.”

This supplication, which is reported from Imam AliAmeer al-Momineen(a.s.) at the Night of Mabit, is advisably said each morning and evening.

In Tahdhib al-Ahkam (by Shaykh al-Tusi), it is reported that whoever repeats the following litany ten times after the dawn (fajr) Prayers, Almighty Allah will save him from blindness, insanity, leprosy, poverty, and (house) demolition or dotage:
All glory be to Allah, the All-great and in praise of Him;

verses.arabic: وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ
verses.translation: and there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All- high and All-great.

Shaykh al-Kulayni reports Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq(a.s.) as saying: Whoever repeats the following litany seven times after the dawn (fajr) and Sunset Prayers, Almighty Allah will saved him from seventy kinds of misfortune the least of which are flatulence, leprosy, and insanity; and his name will be erased from the list of the condemned ones, if it was listed there, and will be added to the list of the happy ones:
In the Name of Allah the All- compassionate, the All-merciful;

verses.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ
verses.translation: there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high and All-great.

Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq(a.s.) is also reported to have said that one who desires to enjoy both the worldly life and the Next World, and one who has eye ache, should utter the following supplicatory prayer after the dawn (fajr) and Sunset Prayers:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْكَ
verses.translation: O Allah, I do beseech You, in the name of the right of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad that is incumbent upon You

verses.arabic: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and to make light in my sight,
discerning in my religion,
conviction in my heart,
sincerity in my deeds,
safety in my self,
richness in my sustenance,

verses.arabic: وَ الشُّكْرَ لَكَ اَبَدًا مَا اَبْقَيْتَنِيْ
verses.translation: and perpetual thankfulness for You as long as you keep me alive.

In ‘Uddat al-Dai, Shaykh Ibn Fahad reports Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida(a.s.) to have said: Whoever says the following statement after the dawn (fajr) Prayer, will have all his requests made easy-to-gain for him and will be saved by Almighty Allah against every thing that aggrieves him:
In the Name of Allah.

verses.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ
verses.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his Household.
“I confide my cause unto Allah.
Surely, Allah is Seer of His slaves.
So, Allah warded off from him the evils which they plotted.”
“There is no god save You. Be You Glorified!
Lo! I have been a wrongdoer.

verses.arabic: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَ نَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ
verses.translation: Then, We heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish.
Thus do We save the believers.”
“Allah is Sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust.

verses.arabic: فَانْقَلَبُوْا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللّٰهِ وَ فَضْلٍ
verses.translation: So, they returned with grace and favor from Allah,
and no harm touched them.”
Only that which Allah wills shall come to pass.

verses.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
verses.translation: There is neither strength nor power save with Allah.

verses.arabic: مَا شَاۤءَ اللهُ لَا مَا شَاۤءَ النَّاسُ،
verses.translation: Only that which Allah, but not people, wills shall come to pass.

verses.arabic: مَا شَاۤءَ اللهُ وَ اِنْ كَرِهَ النَّاسُ
verses.translation: Only that which Allah wills shall come to pass even if people detest it.
Sufficient for me is the Lord against the lorded.
Sufficient for me is the Creator against the creatures.
Sufficient for me is the Sustainer against the sustained.
Sufficient for me is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
Sufficient for me is He Who is sufficient for me.
Sufficient for me is He Who has been always sufficient for me.

verses.arabic: حَسْبِيْ مَنْ كَانَ مُذْ كُنْتُ لَمْ يَزَلْ حَسْبِيْ
verses.translation: Sufficient for me is He Who had been since eternity and still sufficient for me.

verses.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ
verses.translation: “Allah suffices me. There is no god save Him.
In Him have I put my trust,
and He is the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.”
